results.description:
Welcome to The Arsenal, the new digital home of Arsenal Football Club. 

The Arsenal brings you closer than ever to your club, wherever you are in the world. Create an account to get your own personalised feed, and be the first to see exclusive Arsenal content from your favourite players, the latest Gunners news, tickets, merch and experiences. 

PERSONALISED ARSENAL CONTENT

- Get the stories, videos and updates that matter most, with personalised Arsenal content tailored just for you from our men’s, women’s and academy teams. 

-Enjoy exclusive access to a new club podcast, documentaries, entertainment series, training clips, tactical analysis, and player interviews you won’t find anywhere else.

-Get squad insights and post-match analysis from our men’s, women’s and academy football teams, with exclusive training camp coverage during pre-season. 

-Relive top goals, club documentaries, and classic matches from our history.

NEVER MISS A MOMENT

-Follow every fixture with Live from N5, giving you match commentary, real-time football scores, and minute-by-minute coverage of our men’s, women’s and academy games.

-Keep on top of all the action with instant notifications, match updates, highlights and stats across all competitions in our Match Centre. 

-See the latest team lineups, transfer news and manager press conferences. 

YOUR TICKET TO THE ARSENAL 

-Buy and manage your matchday tickets with our Ticketing Hub. Scan into Emirates Stadium on matchday straight from The Arsenal app. 

-Instantly share tickets with friends and family. 

-Get the latest match day live updates and travel info straight to your phone.

-Be the first to hear when priority windows and ballots open.

-Get priority access to special events at Emirates Stadium. 


Terms of Use & Privacy Policy

By downloading this app you agree to our Terms of Use (http://www.arsenal.com/mobiletermsandconditions) and Privacy Policy (http://www.arsenal.com/privacy-policy, a copy of which can also be found on these pages).
results.releaseNotes:
• Enhanced push notifications so they take you straight to the content.
• Enhanced accessibility features to ensure you can follow the action seamlessly.
• Fixed article rendering issues so news and updates load perfectly.
• Fixed retail and cart bugs to make purchasing merch smoother.
• Resolved the video autoplay bug so you never miss a moment of the action.
• Restored gradients and aligned UI styling.
• Upgraded behind-the-scenes systems with critical security patches to keep your data safe.
